name: Shiori
message: "I didn't really feel anything when we first came here, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "The room I used to live in is still here..."

name: Shiori
message: "But it's not the room I know anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "My family is gone, and even the furniture has been replaced..."

name: Shiori
message: "I wonder how long they stayed here after the incident."

name: Shiori
message: "If they moved out right away, then it's been five years..."

name: Shiori
message: "If it's been that long, even the scent would've faded by now."

name: Shiori
message: "There's nothing left to be nostalgic about anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry, I got a little sentimental there."
